integrity: Uniform theorem proved by explicit ideal-quotient obstructions, the essential socle, finite product decomposition and annihilator topology. Finite tests run independently of the proof; no third-party certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only commutative unital Artinian rings, with zero ring understood as an empty-factor case.
No assertion for non-Artinian or noncommutative rings.
Finite enumeration illustrates but does not establish the general theorem.
Historical lattice-theoretic equivalents remain a literature risk; the closest primary article could not be fully re-opened in a later retrieval.
title: The coprime spectrum of a commutative Artinian ring detects precisely its Gorenstein local factors
